### Make Every Moment Count
Author: Melissa Kruger
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/make-every-moment-count
Passage: 1 Peter 1:13
Points:
- Cultural mantras urge people to chase temporary pleasures, fueling self-centeredness and a fear of missing out.
- Earthly pursuits cannot satisfy the soul because human beings were made to find fulfillment in God alone.
- Believers have an imperishable, secure inheritance guaranteed through the resurrection of Jesus Christ.
- Fixing our hope completely on eternal grace frees us to live purposefully and invest in God's kingdom.

### Are You Ready to Go?
Author: Glynnis Whitwer
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/are-you-ready-to-go-encouragement-for-today-apr-25-2013.html
Passage: 1 Peter 1:13
Points:
- God loves all His children equally, but He uses each person differently according to their readiness.
- Comfort, distraction, and poor life management can cause believers to miss divine opportunities.
- God extends invitations to service to those whose minds are alert and listening for His promptings.
- Keeping an expectant and obedient posture allows believers to participate actively in God's work.
